key_insight: Adding an unbalanced optimal-transport loss helps a Diffusion Transformer forecast limit-order volume distributions while preserving price placement and total volume.
engineering_relevance: This is financial-market forecasting research, not materials discovery, but its geometry-aware approach may inform engineering models of unnormalized spatial fields.
method: Condition on the current order book and recent order flow to forecast bid and ask volume-at-price fields over five minutes.
Train a conditional Diffusion Transformer with an auxiliary unbalanced optimal-transport loss.
Evaluate full-field fidelity and uncertainty using transport costs, proper scoring rules, and calibration diagnostics.
evidence_signal: Across 1,950 validation conditions covering 30 U.S. equities, adding UOT reduced full-field transport cost by 45.8% and transport energy score by 26.1% versus MSE-only training, with both improving for every stock.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish generalization beyond the evaluated equities or applicability to materials-science datasets.
paper_title: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
